title: Onboarding overlay resumes stale legacy queue before ingest note check
summary: The dashboard onboarding check currently probes existing queue locations before it searches for current `[ingest]` note nodes. In this workspace, `bench/onboard/zonoid/onboard-queue.json` is incomplete at 210/1691 with 89 kept and 0 injected, so the page resumes that legacy queue and shows the learning overlay even though `/search?workspace=/Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid&q=ingest&k=5` already returns `[ingest]` notes. Fix direction: detect existing `[ingest]` notes before resuming stale queues, or ignore incomplete legacy queues once current graph notes exist.
